analysis:
Integration of both source-pass analyses plus the replayed changelog and docs patches found no concrete security regression supported by visible lines. The replayed evidence covers only part of the PR (373 units reviewed, 361 omitted, complete=false), so the code-level conclusions rest on prior analyses and not on directly verified source.

Changes examined:
- GLM-5.3-Flash JSON mode, json_schema, forced tool_choice and strict tools are now served by withholding output until it is validated. Failures return 422 with no content. Media combined with these modes is refused. These changes only add rejections, so they do not weaken A-001 handling.
- Native-engine logprob and token-constraint refusals are typed 400s issued before reservation, which avoids the breaker-poisoning DoS (T-010).
- The managed GLM load's per-file SHA-256 is now the published weight hash. The separate pre- and post-load hash passes are removed.
- New VerifiedWeightHashStore (~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json, 0600) is keyed on dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime, so registration can reuse a recorded hash without reading the bytes.
- Page-cache and purgeable pages now count as available memory (availability only).
- Wired-limit advice prints text only and executes nothing.

Open contracts for deeper review (T-012, T-027, A-004, T-041):
1. The VerifiedWeightHashStore record is operator-writable. Confirm it is integrity-bound, that any mismatch forces a full hash, and that the registered hash cannot diverge from what the load verified.
2. The 'unchanged file identity' check is only stat-based. The operator is adversarial, and stat metadata can be forged by an operator who controls the files. The coordinator's weight-hash trust is already self-reported, and the load re-verifies every file's SHA-256, so no bypass is evidenced.
3. Confirm the nil/mismatch fail-closed behavior in GLM5NextManagedLoad and requireGLM5NextLoadedArtifact.
4. Confirm GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice does not log prompt-derived error text.
5. Confirm the loadWeightHasher test seams are not reachable in production.
6. The mlx-swift-lm submodule bump has no visible diff.
7. The variable-frame-rate video decode has no visible source; check T-050 temp-file handling.
